title: Hearts & Pans — Boutique Bakery, Lagos
description: Boutique bakery in Victoria Island, Lagos, open every day 10am–8pm. Cinnamon rolls, cakes, cupcakes, doughnuts and cold-pressed juices.

hero.text: Home and heart baked cinnamon rolls, cakes, cupcakes, doughnuts and cold-pressed juices. See today's menu and prices, order ahead and pick up, or get it delivered.

main.alt: Tray of freshly baked cinnamon rolls

mini.alt: Pink buttercream cake with gold butterflies

items.title: Cinnamon rolls & babka
items.text: Soft, gooey rolls in classic and special flavours.

items.title: Custom cakes
items.text: Birthday and celebration cakes, decorated to order.

items.title: Cupcakes & treat boxes
items.text: Oreo, red velvet and vanilla cupcakes, cookies and parfaits, boxed for gifting.

items.title: Juices & yoghurt
items.text: Cold-pressed juices and our thick vanilla yoghurt that customers keep asking for.

feature.title: Open every day
feature.sub: 7 Bishop Aboyade Cole Street, Victoria Island
feature.text: Drop in for something fresh from the oven, or catch us at pop-ups like the Knorr Jollof Fest and the Fashion Souk. On the live site the full menu and prices sit in one place instead of in Instagram highlights, with order-ahead pickup.
feature.ctaMsg: On the live site customers choose a pickup time and pay online before they arrive.

booking.title: Order ahead
booking.text: Tell us what you'd like and when. We'll confirm by WhatsApp and have it ready.
terms: 7 Bishop Aboyade Cole Street, Victoria Island, Lagos.
booking.termsNote: Custom cake lead times would come from Hearts & Pans' own policy.

footer.blurb: Boutique bakery in Lagos. Luxuriously self-indulgent, home and heart baked. Home of pastry lovers.
